docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Twenty-five tales told by a vampire to King Vikram, from the Sanskrit Vetālapañcaviṃśati, in Burton’s English retelling of 1870.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Vetālapañcaviṃśati, in the English version of Sir Richard F. Burton (1821–1890), 1870, with illustrations by Ernest Griset (1843–1893). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
